rw:ingredients.rw:note: The source calls 250 g '2 sticks'. Two US sticks are 226.8 g. The cake recipe by the same author calls the same thing 225 g.

rw:ingredients.rw:originalText: 500g / 1 lb soft icing sugar/powdered sugar, sifted
3 tsp vanilla extract (or vanilla bean paste)
2-4 tbsp milk or cream, to adjust thickness if needed
rw:ingredients.rw:note: A consistency adjuster, not a structural ingredient — excluded from the yield for that reason. Contrast the chocolate recipe, where milk is a required 1/4 cup.

recipeInstructions.text: Cream butter using paddle attachment on high for 3 minutes until it changes from yellow to almost white and becomes fluffy and creamy.
Add icing sugar gradually in 3 lots, beating slowly to avoid powder clouds. Once mostly incorporated, beat on high for 3 minutes until fluffy.
Add vanilla and milk, then beat 30 seconds more. Use milk only if needed to achieve a soft consistency that still holds its form. Use immediately on cooled cakes and cupcakes.

rw:notes: Use soft icing sugar (Australian); pure icing sugar behaves differently.
The paddle attachment prevents excess aeration better than the whisk attachment.
Butter must be softened to room temperature.
